entry.title: The 27 hours before the PumpSwap upgrade
entry.summary: I replayed the buffer of the PumpSwap upgrade of 15 November 2026 transaction by transaction: its code was fully written at 13:49:06 UTC on 14 November and ran at 17:20:20 UTC on 15 November, 27 hours 31 minutes later.

entry.title: Errata E-2026-11-23: the note on the PumpSwap buffer took a transfer for the last write
entry.summary: The note on the PumpSwap buffer gave 13:49:21 UTC, the time of a transaction that sends 1 lamport to each of 19 accounts, as the last write, a wait of 27 h 30 min 59 s, and counted 1,258 transactions as writes; the last write is at 13:49:06 UTC, the wait is 27 h 31 min 14 s, and 1,256 of those transactions hold a write

entry.title: Compound 619: queued, then canceled by the Guardian Safe
entry.summary: I read the governance of Compound on Ethereum mainnet at the block before one transaction and at a recent block, on two public archive nodes. Proposal 619 went from Queued to Canceled; the Proposal Guardian, the Guardian expiry, the Timelock delay and the Timelock admin read the same on both sides.

entry.title: Build on the oracle
entry.summary: Three recipes to build on the Authority Risk Oracle, all replayable and all on test networks: read a score on-chain, check the signed files of the Watch without trusting me, and put a guard in front of an action. A score is a reading, not a verdict.

entry.title: The same address is not the same keys
entry.summary: I read the same address on six networks for the 89 Safe addresses in the Watch registry: 30 are a Safe on two or more of them, and 12 of those have other signers or another threshold on at least one network. One of them reads 6 of 10 on Ethereum mainnet and 2 of 9 on Arbitrum One.

entry.title: PumpSwap upgrade: a 3-of-4 vault, no time lock
entry.summary: On 2026-11-15, 17:20:20 UTC, the PumpSwap program on Solana mainnet-beta was upgraded by a Squads vault that needs 3 of 4 signers and has a time lock of 0 seconds. The new code had been on chain in a buffer for about 27 hours.

entry.title: The Authority Report, number 0
entry.summary: Who can change what, replayed every Monday. This first number covers 202 targets on nine networks and ends with one question: would a protocol publish a commitment anyone could check every day?

entry.title: I edited my own history, and the chain noticed
entry.summary: Every event my Watch has seen is linked to the one before it by the SHA-256 of that line. I changed one value in line 101 of a copy and the check fell from 291 of 291 to 290 of 291.

entry.title: Five new keys, threshold five
entry.summary: On 11 November, in one transaction on Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1), a Safe that Aave's address book lists as GOVERNANCE_GUARDIAN replaced five of its nine signers. The five new keys are enough to reach its threshold of five.

entry.title: Check my scores in one command
